keyPoints: Prakash (light) hamesha seedhi rekha me chalta hai — isi vajah se chhaya (shadow) banti hai.
Paravartan (reflection): prakash ka kisi satah se takra kar laut aana — jaise sheeshe me chehra dikhna.
Paravartan ka niyam: aapatan kon hamesha paravartan kon ke barabar hota hai.
Apavartan (refraction): ek madhyam se doosre me jaane par prakash ka mud jaana — paani me sikka utha hua dikhna.
Shwet prakash me 7 rang chhupe hote hain (VIBGYOR) — prism se guzarne par ye bikharkar dikhte hain.
Uttal lens (convex) prakash ko paas laata hai, avtal lens (concave) use faila deta hai.
Manav netra me prakash retina par pratibimb banata hai; aankh ki putli (iris) andar aane wali roshni ko control karti hai.
